name: Minagi Suzuri
source:
She is a teacher in the magical section. 

[spoiler]She is the biological mother of [url=/c10382]Yuuma Kohinata[/url]. She was forced to entrust her son, Yuuma, to her close friend, [url=/c10405]Otoha[/url], because of many tragic things that had happened. She erased Yuuma's memory of her before going separate ways. She revealed the whole story to [url=/c10383]Haruhi[/url] and [url=/c10384]Anri[/url] of what had happened in the past.[/spoiler]

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Happiness!#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
